words.prose: {{ar:لَّسْتَ}} ({{tr:lasta}}) carries the same addressed figure from the reminder-role in 88:21 into a direct denial of controller-status. Because it is laysa-type copular negation, the clause is not simply saying not to perform one act; it says the addressee is not constituted as the role named at the end. The opening negation governs the whole relation, so {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) and {{ar:بِمُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:bi-muṣayṭirin}}) are heard inside one boundary: reminder remains assigned, coercive authority over response does not. This also fits the wider laysa-framed boundary in 2:272, where outcome-burden is denied, and the surah-local return from failed nourishment in 88:6 to denied control in 88:22 makes negation mark what cannot perform the imagined function. The compact sound of {{ar:لَّسْتَ}} ({{tr:lasta}}) makes non-control the first frame heard before the title is named, while the next exception in 88:23 can mark refusal without making refusal a failure of prophetic control.

words.prose: {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) turns the denial into a relation over a human domain. The preposition {{ar:عَلَى}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) does not make them a direct object; it makes control sound like a posture of authority above them, the very posture refused. Its placement before the final title lets the audience-domain appear before the controller-role is named, and the heard ending runs straight into the following predicate phrase, audibly tying that domain to the title being denied. The same prepositional pressure becomes a responsibility switch in the passage: 88:22 denies control over them, while 88:26 places reckoning upon Us, and 42:48 limits the messenger's burden to conveyance. The group can then narrow into the marked refuser in 88:23, so non-control over the plural domain does not erase individual accountability.

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is small but not ornamental. After {{ar:لَّسْتَ}} ({{tr:lasta}}), it governs the final predicate and strengthens the denial, so the role is excluded with emphatic syntax rather than treated as an instrument. The particle is split in analysis but fused in the heard and written phrase {{ar:بِمُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:bi-muṣayṭirin}}), making reinforcement and title arrive together at the clause's end as if the role is fastened to the clause only to be rejected. It also acts as the hinge from {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) to the excluded role, a structurally barred alternative that resonates with the bāʾ-marked non-compulsion formula in 50:45.

topics.reason: In local order, {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) introduces the final predicate after {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}); the same bāʾ-marked negated-role pattern is visible in {{ar:بِجَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:bi-jabbārin}}) at 50:45, and the following turn in 88:23 does not undo the exclusion.

words.prose: {{ar:مُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:muṣayṭirin}}) is the final title the clause has been excluding, withheld until the close so the rejected model can land with full weight. Its active participial form makes the addressee the possible role-holder, its indefiniteness broadens the denial to any such controller-role, and {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) keeps the people as the domain over which that role would operate. The selected sense is coercive authority-over, not neutral supervision, because 88:21 has just affirmed the reminder role and this word names the rival office. The {{ar:س ط ر}} ({{tr:s-ṭ-r}}) field narrows locally to control, yet its line, record, and written-order branches still color the denied authority as arranging or fixing people into an imposed order. Variant pressures at the final word test sound, case, and active/passive direction, but the canonical form remains the active controller-title being denied; its sibilant-emphatic cadence gives the title a heavy controlling texture before the denial releases it. The same rare active title is marked against the field's record and writtenness uses, paired with control-claims in 52:37, contrasted with force-language in 50:45, and answered inside the surah by the accounting assignment in 88:26: control is refused to the messenger, reckoning is reserved elsewhere. The next movement can mark the refuser in 88:23 and divine consequence in 88:24 without converting that consequence into prophetic control.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word names a standing role-holder assigned to the singular addressee, while the plural group remains the domain over which that role is denied.
topics.reason: The local form is an active participial predicate governed by {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), indefinite under negation, and connected to {{ar:عَلَيْهِم}} ({{tr:ʿalayhim}}) as its authority domain.

topics.headline: controller is the rival mission role
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final title defines the mission by contrast: reminder is affirmed in 88:21, coercive mastery is excluded in 88:22.
topics.reason: The predicate selects coercive authority-over rather than neutral supervision because it follows the reminder command in 88:21 and is denied as the counter-role to {{ar:مُذَكِّرٌ}} ({{tr:mudhakkirun}}).

topics.headline: line and record field colors control as imposed order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied control feels like arranging, registering, and fixing people into an imposed order, while the selected local role remains controller.
topics.reason: V4 separates written-line and false-record branches from the control branch, so the writing and record field should color the selected controller-role as image-pressure rather than replace it with literal writing or fabricated tales.

topics.headline: variant pressure tests sound, case, and agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that variant pressures gather at the final title, but the canonical reading keeps the addressee as the active role-holder being denied.
topics.reason: The sibilant variants affect acoustic color, and the passive-like or case-disrupting reports expose role-direction and government pressure; they do not overturn the canonical active participial predicate {{ar:مُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:muṣayṭirin}}).

topics.headline: parallel shifts from force to supervisory control
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 50:45 denies overpowering force, while 88:22 denies supervisory control, sharpening the type of authority excluded here.
topics.reason: The parallel is concrete: 50:45 uses {{ar:بِجَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:bi-jabbārin}}) over them, while 88:22 uses {{ar:بِمُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:bi-muṣayṭirin}}), both under negation but with different role-nouns.

topics.headline: rare title is paired with cosmic control-claims
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rare controller title is alien both to opponent claims in 52:37 and to the messenger's mission in 88:22.
topics.reason: The concrete pair is 52:37, where {{ar:ٱلْمُصَيْطِرُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muṣayṭirūn}}) mocks control-claims, and 88:22, where {{ar:مُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:muṣayṭirin}}) is denied to the addressee.

topics.headline: denied control is answered by divine reckoning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that control over them is not handed to the messenger because account over them is assigned to Us in 88:26.
topics.reason: The same closing unit contrasts {{ar:بِمُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:bi-muṣayṭirin}}) in 88:22 with {{ar:عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم}} ({{tr:ʿalaynā ḥisābahum}}) in 88:26, relocating final authority from control to reckoning.

topics.headline: final word lands as the excluded model
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause withholds the title until the final word can land as the exact model being rejected.
topics.reason: The word order places {{ar:مُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:muṣayṭirin}}) at the close of the clause, so the final position carries the denied mission-model.

topics.headline: sound gives the denied title final weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sound and cadence make the excluded title feel weighty before releasing it as denied.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are local sound payoffs: {{ar:مُصَيْطِرٍ}} ({{tr:muṣayṭirin}}) carries the final sibilant-emphatic texture and nasal close, while the grammar remains the active predicate under negation.

topics.headline: active controller title is distributionally marked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this is not ordinary authority vocabulary but a marked active controller title within a field more often tied to records and writtenness.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root and active participial title as low-occurrence, supporting the CRITICAL claim that the role-word stands out without making other root branches literally local.

topics.headline: non-control permits refusal but leaves consequence elsewhere

topics.reason: The forward context is concrete: 88:23 marks the refuser, and 88:24 assigns consequence to {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}), preserving non-control while maintaining accountability.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The whole predication in lَsta alayhim bi-musaytir joins emphatic negation to a relational position over them.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause denies a presently holding office, and the denied office bundles oversight, preservation, and domination. It therefore marks a jurisdictional boundary rather than merely predicting that persuasion will fail.

activation_trace.role: The fixed present-state negation, reinforced in the predicate construction, denies that this supervisory relation presently holds.
Overseeing, preserving, and controlling authority supplies the office that is being denied.

changed_reading.after: You are emphatically not installed over them as their guardian-controller; the line limits jurisdiction, not simply effectiveness.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Musaytir carries the same focus root whose inventory includes both control and the aligned written row.
baseline_models.mechanism: Control can be pictured as fixing persons into a legible line or record. Categorical negation blocks the speaker from becoming the one who writes, ranks, or fixes their responses into such an order.

activation_trace.role: Categorical negation excludes the addressee from the class of totalizing arrangers.
The aligned written row turns abstract control into fixing people as ordered entries.
The supervisory branch links that row image back to the actual predicate of authority.

changed_reading.before: You are not a ruler over them.
changed_reading.after: You are not the registrar-arranger who fixes their places, responses, or outcomes into a humanly controlled row.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening casts the addressee as recipient and transmitter of arriving news, while the announced event bears the image of comprehensive covering. The later denial of control keeps the reporter from being confused with the event that overwhelms.

activation_trace.role: Supervisory control names the encompassing relation denied of the reporter.
Arrival makes the discourse something that comes to the addressee before being passed onward.
Renewed report or news defines the communicative medium rather than an enforcement act.
Comprehensive covering belongs to the announced event, supplying the enveloping force from which the speaker is distinguished.

structural_cues: The opening question makes the addressee a recipient of a report, while the event is the grammatical topic of that report.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, renewed report, and comprehensive cover; I infer an agency contrast in which the speaker transmits what the event itself does. A live alternative is that the covering term functions only as the event's title, leaving a simpler reporter-versus-controller contrast.

changed_reading.before: The speaker lacks control over the audience.
changed_reading.after: The speaker reports the force that will encompass; he is not himself an encompassing force laid over the audience.

context_deltas.mechanism: Work and purposeful striving are predicated of the faces, and the later possessive makes the striving theirs. Because the striving inventory also contains administration over a people, the focus negation blocks a transfer from their action to his management of them.

activation_trace.role: Supervisory control supplies the external management from which the addressee is excluded.
Intended action locates operative effort in the described subjects.
Purposeful movement toward an object gives their striving its own direction and agency.
Administration over a people supplies the nearby role that the focus refuses to assign to the speaker.
Satisfaction attaches an experienced evaluation to the subject's own striving rather than to imposed performance.

structural_cues: The possessive in 'its striving' binds effort to the face whose condition is being described.
The two face sequences display outcomes without assigning the messenger as producer of either outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies intended work, purposeful striving, a branch of administration over people, and satisfaction; I infer that negated control preserves the subjects' ownership of action. The alternative is that satisfaction concerns reward alone and carries no agency contrast.

changed_reading.after: Their striving remains theirs to enact and encounter; he is not appointed to administer people so as to manufacture either face or outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant mapping from the watering occurrence activates driving, herding, and following one track. Against musaytir, this yields a social mechanism in which coercive control would treat hearers as a driven herd; the negation refuses that mode.

activation_trace.role: Controlling authority supplies the social force that can be recast as driving a group.
The split-root image of driving, herding, or expulsion renders control as force applied to collective movement.
Following in one track supplies the imposed uniform path that the denied controller would enforce.

structural_cues: The source occurrence is passive watering, while the packet deliberately preserves a non-dominant S-W-Q target beside the dominant S-Q-Y target.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the split mapping and its driving and one-track images; I infer a herd-driving analogy for coercive control. The materially live alternative is that this is only mapping resonance with no lexical pressure on the focus clause.

changed_reading.before: He is not able to compel assent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, he is not to drive hearers as a herd or force all movement into one track.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier explicit laysa-plus-exception construction activates the exception branch, and a later illa man follows immediately after the focus negation. This creates a live scope fork rather than allowing the categorical baseline to pass untested.

activation_trace.role: Categorical negation supplies the initially unqualified role boundary whose scope is put under pressure.
The controlling office is the possible target of the later exception's backward pressure.
The exclusion branch is made explicit by the earlier no-food-except construction and primes exception-sensitive hearing.
Turning away identifies the person introduced by the later exception and supplies the exceptional case.

structural_cues: Verse 88:6 contains an explicit laysa ... illa pattern.
Verse 88:23 begins with illa man directly after the focus clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the earlier exception template and the later leading illa; I infer a formal echo that reopens the scope of 88:22. One reading keeps the no-control clause absolute and attaches the exception to the reminder sequence; another lets the exception press on the denial, though the following attribution of punishment to God sharply constrains that reading.

changed_reading.before: The controller role is categorically and simply excluded.
changed_reading.after: The boundary remains strong but carries an unresolved exception fork: either 88:23 qualifies the reception or consequence of reminder, or it presses against the scope of no-control without transferring divine punishment to the messenger.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sequence of raised, placed, lined, spread, measured, erected, and extended things presents an already ordered environment through passive forms. The written-row branch of the focus root now becomes contrastive: the addressee discloses order and asks others to inspect it, but does not impose an analogous order on people.

activation_trace.role: The aligned written row supplies the human-ordering image that the contextual rows and placements activate.
Supervisory authority would turn perceived order into an office of ordering people, which the clause denies.
Raising begins the passive arrangement sequence with an object already set high.
Placement in a settled position contributes deliberate spatial disposition without naming the human addressee as placer.
Alignment on a level line directly activates the focus root's row image.
Distribution and spreading shows that order can include patterned dispersion rather than only rigid rows.
Measuring and proportioning supplies the generative intelligence behind visible order.
Erecting something upright and prominent extends the ordered passive pattern into the landscape.
A level extended surface closes the sequence with broad horizontal ordering.

structural_cues: Passive result forms recur across 88:13-20 while the arranging agent remains unexpressed.
The branchless root K-Y-F repeats in 88:17-20 as a structural invitation to inspect how the order is made; no branch identifier is inferred for it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rows, placements, distribution, measured creation, erection, extension, and repeated how-questions; I infer a contrast between witnessing given order and arranging human beings. The alternative is that the focus row branch is dormant word history and the sequence only illustrates divine power.

changed_reading.before: He is not the authority who controls their response.
changed_reading.after: He points people toward an order already made; he is not commissioned to reproduce that order by placing, lining, or fixing people himself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The looking inventory contains both self-directed perception and a guard who watches and preserves. The context asks the audience to exercise the first, while the focus denies the speaker the second; evidence is offered for their seeing rather than surveillance being placed over them.

activation_trace.role: Overseeing and preserving control supplies the watcher-like office denied of the addressee.
Directing sight or insight makes perception an act performed by the audience.
The watching guard supplies the surveillance alternative that the focus controller branch rejects.

structural_cues: The repeated ila ... kayfa sequence in 88:17-20 directs the audience outward to inspect; K-Y-F is used only as a branchless structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perceptive looking and guarding as coexisting branches; I assign the first to the hearers and use the second as a contrastive gloss on denied control. The alternative is that the guard branch is inactive and the passage makes only an epistemic appeal.

changed_reading.before: He may explain but cannot compel.
changed_reading.after: His address opens a field for their own seeing; it does not install him as the watcher who monitors and preserves their response.

context_deltas.mechanism: Reminder works by bringing something back into presence after forgetfulness; control works by externally overseeing and maintaining its object. The adjacent role restriction therefore makes the addressee catalytic rather than custodial.

activation_trace.role: Present-state negation sharply closes the role definition begun in the preceding verse.
External oversight and preservation name the custodial mechanism excluded from reminding.
Recollection after forgetfulness locates the decisive reactivation within the recipient.
A reminder as the means of recalling defines the limited instrument the addressee is authorized to be.

structural_cues: The restrictive role formula in 88:21 is immediately followed by the matched second-person predication in 88:22.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recollection, a reminder-instrument, a restrictive role formula, and negated oversight; I infer a causal distinction between triggering recall and maintaining obedience. The alternative is that reminder remains a forceful command, but that does not erase the explicit denial of the controlling office.

changed_reading.before: His job is to preach, not force.
changed_reading.after: His authorized action is to reactivate what recipients can remember; he is not responsible for externally maintaining the resulting state in them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse renders nonresponse as a person's directional turning and covering of truth. Because the messenger is not controller, refusal remains attributable to the one who turns rather than becoming a defect he must erase by force.

activation_trace.role: Denied control prevents the speaker from taking over the respondent's directional and moral act.
Turning the face makes reception or refusal a directional act of the addressed person.
Turning away supplies the concrete withdrawal that control would otherwise try to prevent.
Concealing the truth gives the respondent's refusal an inward operation as well as an outward turn.

structural_cues: The singular relative person in 88:23 carries both verbs, concentrating agency in the respondent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies face-turning, withdrawal, and concealment; I infer that the no-control clause preserves attribution of response to the respondent. The alternative is that these are only moral labels, not a statement about the mechanics of agency.

changed_reading.after: Turning away remains the rejecter's own directional and concealing act; the messenger's boundary preserves, rather than absorbs, that responsibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the denial of control, punishment receives an explicit divine subject, and return and accounting are assigned with first-person divine prepositional phrases. The focus is therefore a distribution of jurisdiction: reminder is delegated, coercive sanction and final account are not.

activation_trace.role: The denied package of oversight and domination is separated into functions subsequently assigned elsewhere.
Painful punishment supplies the sanction that is not delegated to the messenger.
The worshiped divine referent is the explicitly named agent to whom sanction belongs.
Return to the place of return supplies the terminal movement assigned to the divine side.
Counting and accounting supplies the final evaluative operation reserved beyond the messenger's office.

structural_cues: Verse 88:24 names Allah as grammatical agent of punishment.
The matched ilayna and alayna constructions in 88:25-26 assign return and account to the same non-messenger party.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit divine punishing agent plus assigned return and account; I infer a non-delegation of sanction and adjudication. The alternative is to hear only consolation about eventual outcome, but the repeated grammatical assignment still creates a jurisdictional contrast.

changed_reading.before: The messenger simply lacks enough power to control.
changed_reading.after: His non-control is an authorized division of labor: he reminds, while punitive force, return, and accounting are expressly not delegated to him.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets a context root inventory illuminate the unrooted prepositional construction alayhim. It remains anchored in the focus construction joining 'over them' to musaytir and in the context branch of domination; render it as a spatial-social echo, not as an etymology of the preposition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The phrase alayhim places the denied controller in a geometrically over-them relation.

activation_trace.role: Controlling oversight converts the focus preposition's vertical relation into social superposition.
Domination and taking possession make height a political relation rather than mere elevation.
The branch explicitly gathering ala and related usage links contextual height to the focus construction.

surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus negation and denied supervisory role meet within a root inventory that also carries patient bearing and overlooking.

activation_trace.role: Forbearing load-bearing and good-natured overlooking supplies a positive manner for inhabiting the negation of control.

changed_reading.after: As a contained ethical echo, the removal of control opens a mode of patient bearing and overlooking while reminder continues.

strongest_changes: The negation became a jurisdictional allocation rather than a statement of failed persuasion: reminder is assigned to the addressee, while sanction, return, and account are assigned elsewhere.
The audience's looking, remembering, striving, turning, and concealing remain their own operations; the messenger catalyzes but does not administer them.
Rows, placements, and passively ordered creation activated the focus root's line image, yielding a distinction between disclosing order and imposing order on people.
The explicit exception patterns preserve a real scope fork around 88:23 instead of allowing an artificially settled single reading.
summary.what_was_special: The packet turned a familiar no-compulsion line into several mechanisms at once: jurisdictional non-delegation, recipient-owned cognition and action, non-surveillance, and refusal to arrange people as rows, records, or a driven herd. The odd branches did not displace the ordinary control sense; they made its material and social implications inspectable.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the exception in 88:23 reaches back toward the control negation or belongs only to the reminder-and-consequence sequence remains deliberately unresolved.
The written-row and cutting-line branches are exact to the focus root but may be inactive historical or collateral images in the surface form.
The herd-driving reading depends on the packet's non-dominant S-Q-Y to S-W-Q mapping and may be structural resonance rather than lexical activation.
The present-state force of laysa does not by itself settle whether the denied office is only current, permanently excluded, or being defined categorically by context.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Negated present-state control.** Evidence: `ل ي س` B001 present-state denial; `س طر` B003 overseeing control. Structural cue: the line directly limits the preceding command to remind. Role: `لست` removes controlling authority from the messenger. Abductive move: admonition can be obligatory even when enforcement is not delegated. Reading change: the ayah reads as a boundary around prophetic agency.

2. **No written-line domination over persons.** Evidence: `س طر` B001 aligned written row/recording, B003 control; `ذ ك ر` B008 legal instrument; later `ح س ب` B001 account. Structural cue: reminder/record/account language surrounds the control negation. Role: `مسيطر` could imply supervisory record-control, but it is denied here. Abductive move: the final record belongs elsewhere; the reminder does not own the ledger. Reading change: the ayah separates notification from accounting authority.

3. **Contrast with ordered rows and spread surfaces.** Evidence: `س طر` B001 rows; earlier `ص فف` B001 rows of cushions, `س طح` B001 flat surface. Structural cue: the surah has many ordered spatial lines, but this line rejects a human controller over people. Role: order is real, but not imposed by the reminder as domination. Abductive move: created/garden order and coercive human control must be distinguished. Reading change: the ayah becomes a theological limit on order-making.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The final divine `علينا حسابهم` made this ayah essential: control and accounting are not absent; they are relocated. The row/surface imagery made `سطر` resonate with ordering, but the negation prevents it from becoming messengerly coercion.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Emphatic negation creates an authority handoff.** **Lexical:** `ل ي س` B001, fixed present-state negation whose inventory explicitly notes emphatic `بـ` in its predicate; `س ط ر` B003, "overseeing control." **Cue:** `بِمُصَيْطِرٍ` follows the restricted reminder-role of 88:21, while God becomes the punishing subject in 88:24 and `علينا` claims return and account in 88:25-26. **Role:** `لست` removes the messenger, control names the removed jurisdiction, and the later first-person plural statements locate ultimate administration elsewhere. **Abduction:** I infer exclusivity from the sequence; the packet does not formulate a legal transfer clause. **Reading change:** the ayah is not generic reassurance but a precise separation of communication from enforcement and reckoning.

2. **The following exception does not restore human control.** **Lexical:** `ل ي س` B002, `laysa` as excluding or excepting, activated by `إِلَّا مَن` at the start of 88:23; `س ط ر` B003 supplies the denied role. **Cue:** cross-ayah `لست ... إلا من تولى وكفر` creates an apparent exception contour, but 88:24 makes God, not the addressee, the punisher. **Role:** B002 opens the possibility that the turner-away is an exception to the control denial; the explicit later agent closes that possibility. **Abduction:** I infer that agent placement resolves the cross-ayah scope. **Reading change:** even the exceptional rejecter does not become subject to messenger-control; the exception instead feeds into divine consequence.

3. **Control is distinguished from record-like ordering and calculation.** **Lexical:** `س ط ر` B001, "aligned written row" and recording line by line, coactivated with B003; `ح س ب` B001 in 88:26 supplies counting and account. **Cue:** the controller term is followed by return and reckoning, not by any human record-keeping action. **Role:** the written-row branch makes oversight legible as registration, while the account root identifies the actual terminal audit. **Abduction:** I infer a record-and-account mechanism from lexical adjacency; no book is named. **Reading change:** `مصيطر` evokes comprehensive administrative registration precisely so that the ayah can deny that function to the messenger.

4. **Visible inquiry does not license domination.** **Lexical:** `س ط ر` B003, overseeing control, contrasted with `ن ظ ر` B001 in 88:17, attentive inspection. **Cue:** looking, comparing, and reminding precede the control negation. **Role:** observation gathers evidence and reminder communicates it; control would govern persons rather than evidence. **Abduction:** I infer a methodological boundary from the ordered verbs. **Reading change:** the ayah protects the observational program from becoming a politics of surveillance.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 88:23's opening `إِلَّا` unexpectedly activated `ل ي س` B002 and momentarily made the control denial look exceptionable. 88:24 corrected that contour by naming God as punisher, and 88:26 further activated `س ط ر` B001's record-like aspect by locating the actual account elsewhere.

lexicalization_scope.note: Devenin yük taşıması temel fiziksel gerçekleşim, insandaki katlanma ile görmezden gelme ise kendi yapılara bağlı insani gerçekleşimler olarak ayrılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Bu dal packet düzeyinde inceleme statüsünde tutulmuş sınır-riskli malzemeyi taşır. Kanıt, tek bir yalın kök imgesinden çok biçime veya özel kullanıma bağlı dağınık adlandırmaları gösterdiği için dal yapısal bölme şartı koşmadan sınırlı bir adlandırma kümesi olarak okunmalıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü doğrudan küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek bir hayvanın adı olarak tanımlar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu tek ve yalın adlandırmayı doğru biçimde yansıtır; yazı, anlatı, denetim veya kesme dallarından herhangi bir anlam buraya taşınmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek yavruyu adlandırır; türün tamamına, dişi yavruya veya genel hayvan adına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim genç erkek küçükbaş hayvanı adlandırır ve herhangi bir söz kalıbına bağlı anlam içermeden tanımlanır.

concept_map.definition: Küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek bir yavruyu adlandıran yalın bir hayvan adıdır.

facets.statement: Gönderge, küçükbaş hayvanlar içinde genç ve erkek bir yavrudur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu hayvan adı tek bir tanıklıkla sınırlı olup küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek bir yavruyu gösterir.

source_details.summary: Söz, küçükbaş hayvanlardan genç erkek bir yavrunun adı olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: genç erkek küçükbaş hayvan
concept_gloss.applicability: Hayvanın küçükbaş oluşu ile gençlik ve erkeklik özelliklerinin birlikte belirtilmesi gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Küçükbaş hayvan sınıfını, gençlik evresini ve erkek cinsiyetini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Küçükbaş sürüsündeki genç erkek hayvanı kısa ve doğal biçimde adlandırmak için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın küçükbaş, genç ve erkek oluşunu açık biçimde korur.
Genç bir küçükbaş yavruyu doğal ve kısa biçimde adlandırır.
error_profile.adds: Erkeklik koşulunu belirtmeden dişi yavruları da kapsayabilir ve hayvanı yalnız keçi türüne daraltabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Küçükbaş yavrunun erkek olması odak dalın ayırt edici özelliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Küçükbaş yavrunun dişi olması komşu dalın ayırt edici özelliğidir.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genç erkek ile genç dişi küçükbaş
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal küçükbaş hayvanların genç yavrularını yaş ve hayvan sınıfı bakımından paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal erkek yavruyu, komşu dal ise dişi yavruyu adlandırır; temel karşıtlık aynı yaş ve hayvan alanındaki cinsiyettir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gençlik evresi ile erkek cinsiyetini birlikte zorunlu kılar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Keçi türünü, erkeği ve dişiyi, tekili ve topluluğu yaş koşulu olmadan genel olarak kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genç erkek yavru ile keçi türü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal küçükbaş hayvan ve özellikle keçi alanında aynı canlı grubuna gönderimde bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yaş ve cinsiyetçe sınırlı bir yavru adıdır; komşu dal keçi türünün genel adı ve çeşitli üyelerini kapsayan geniş bir sınıftır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tek bir genç erkek küçükbaş yavruyu yaş ve cinsiyet özellikleriyle belirtir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Koyun türünü, erkek ve dişi üyeleriyle ve çeşitli çoğul biçimleriyle genel olarak adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genç erkek yavru ile koyun türü
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal küçükbaş hayvanların koyun çevresindeki adlandırma alanında kesişebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal belirli yaş ve cinsiyetteki bireydir; komşu dal yaş ve cinsiyet ayrımı yapmadan koyun türünün genel adlandırmasını verir.

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.
